Before you have power, the Quartz Grindstone is how you turn crystals into dust. It has 7 inventory slots: 3 input, 3 output, and 1 processing slot.

Attach a Wooden Crank to the top and right-click to grind. Each click processes one item. No AE power needed, just good old-fashioned elbow grease.

You can also feed it rotational power from other tech mods for hands-free grinding, but that is overkill for early game.

Dusts are used for circuits, processors, and a bunch of AE2 recipes, so you will be grinding a lot. Consider building a few of these.

§cWARNING:§f The grindstone does not accept items that have no grinder recipe. Check JEI first.
